response.justification: Experienced senior generalist with a strong web/backend background (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) and solid engineering practices, but the profile misses nearly all hard requirements for this role. There is no Japanese language ability (native-level is mandatory), no demonstrated Linux kernel analysis or source modification, and no experience with LAN-switch firmware, L2/L3 networking, MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP/NETCONF, or chip-vendor SDKs. C exposure is limited to a brief 2014–2015 stint at National Instruments and an academic C++ project, over a decade ago. The gap between this candidate's demonstrated domain and embedded network-security firmware development is too wide to bridge in a screening pass.
strengths: 15+ years of software development experience with senior/staff-level roles
Strong testing, TDD, CI/CD and developer-tooling discipline; active open-source contributor
Some low-level and systems exposure (C/C++ at National Instruments, Linux, high-performance async services)
concerns: No Japanese language ability listed — a mandatory native-level requirement
No Linux kernel analysis/modification or embedded firmware experience
No networking security domain knowledge (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3, switch SDKs); C skills dated and secondary
